inputs.original_text: These Phoenix city leaders are pushing yet another scheme to hamstring federal immigration enforcement, with the city council voting Wednesday night to slap new restrictions on ICE and other law enforcement using city property. This is the same old resistance to national authority, where local officials prioritize open borders over the rule of law and the safety of American families. By tying the hands of federal agents, they're inviting more chaos at the border and eroding the basic duty to protect our sovereignty and cultural heritage. It's a clear sign of misplaced priorities that weaken traditional order in favor of activist posturing.
inputs.modified_text: These Phoenix city leaders are at it once more with their schemes to undermine federal immigration enforcement. The city council voted Wednesday night to impose fresh restrictions on ICE and other law enforcement when it comes to using city property. This amounts to the same resistance against national authority that we've seen before, where these officials put open borders ahead of the rule of law and the protection of American families. Tying the hands of federal agents like this is just asking for more chaos at the border and weakens our fundamental responsibility to safeguard our sovereignty and cultural heritage. It's a glaring example of skewed priorities that favor activist posturing over maintaining traditional order.
